title: Hand reveal is gated behind the optional payment/opt-in instead of being unconditional.
expected: insightful-investigator.ts:24-43 — the triggered ability is `optional: true` (line 40) and its sole effect is a `conditional` with `condition: {type:"pay-cost", cost:{xp:2}}` (line 26) whose `then` sequence contains the `reveal-hand` effect (lines 29-33) plus draw. There is no unconditional reveal-hand outside the pay-cost branch and no `else`, so declining the opt-in/payment skips the reveal entirely. The FIXME at lines 18-21 explicitly states the entire reveal-hand+draw sequence was gated behind the XP cost. Rules text (line 57) says reveal is unconditional; only the pick/discard/draw is 'You may pay 2 XP'.
observed: Game C: played Investigator, answered 'No' to the opt-in prompt → trigger ended with no reveal step at all (no reveal/reveal-and-pick pendingChoice, no log entry, state unchanged). The reveal only occurs inside the accepted branch (card def wraps reveal-hand inside the pay-cost conditional; def carries a FIXME acknowledging this).

history.note: reveal-hand now prompts unconditionally; the 2 XP is a new reveal-and-pick pickCost charged only on the pick

resolution.note: reveal-hand now prompts unconditionally; the 2 XP is a new reveal-and-pick pickCost charged only on the pick
